caption: From Atomic Habits to AI prompts, tiny systems beat big plans. Try one book idea with a clear AI prompt today. Which task will you turn into a repeatable AI workflow? #AIforBusiness #ProductivityHacks #SystemsOverGoals #TimeSaver

slides.title: Hard Task Block
slides.body: You keep dodging the hardest task until it blocks your week.

slides.title: Book Idea
slides.body: Idea from Atomic Habits by James Clear: tiny routines compound; build systems, not just goals.

slides.title: Bad Prompt
slides.body: Bad prompt: "Give me my tasks for today."

slides.title: Better Prompt
slides.body: Better prompt: "Act as my AI assistant. List 3 tasks for today with next action each."

slides.title: Example Output
slides.body: Example: Task 1: Prioritize client email; Next: draft reply. Task 2: Review proposal; Next: ask clarifications. Task 3: Outline pitch.

slides.title: Do This Today
slides.body: Task today: run the Better Prompt; check output has 3 tasks, clear next actions, and owners.

slides.title: Takeaway
slides.body: Small routines plus precise prompts yield consistent results.
